He stirred, blinking through the haze. He needed to slip up to his second-floor suite before the domestic staff began their morning rounds. Glancing up at the ceiling mirror, he pinched the bridge of his nose in immediate disgust.

Reflected in the glass, Kang Il-hyun was clinging to his back like a massive, immovable leech, dead asleep.

Jakyeong carefully pried the heavy forearm from his waist, attempting to crawl off the mattress. But before he could even clear the sheets, the arm hooked around his middle, hauling him straight back beneath the duvet.

Il-hyun nestled his face deep into the crook of Jakyeong's neck, murmuring against his skin in a voice thick with sleep:

"Sleep... more."

"Aren't you going to the office today?"

Instead of answering, Il-hyun lazily fondled his chest, his large hand drifting steadily south. The moment fingers brushed over the torn lace, Jakyeong recoiled in horror, swatting the hand away and scrambling out of bed onto the floorboards.

"Looks good on you," Il-hyun drawled, cracking an eye open.

Jakyeong looked down at himself. The lace was ruined, soaked and stiff with dried cum. Cursing under his breath, he ripped the tattered fabric completely off and hurled the scrap straight into Il-hyun's face.

Il-hyun caught it, lifted the silk to his nose, and took a slow, deliberate inhale.

Fucking degenerate. Jakyeong's face contorted in pure revulsion.

When Il-hyun gestured for him to come back, Jakyeong threw on a silk bathrobe and pulled a fresh cigarette from his pack. He struck a flame and walked toward the window, only for heavy arms to wrap around his waist from behind. Resting his chin on Jakyeong’s shoulder, Il-hyun smoothly plucked the lit cigarette from his lips, taking a long drag before slipping it back between Jakyeong's fingers.

His arms tightened around Jakyeong's waist in an iron embrace.

"I don't want to go to work."

Hearing a ruthless syndicate boss whining like a spoiled schoolboy was absurdly funny.

"Then quit."

"Should I? Walk away from the conglomerate and start a watermelon farm out back with my darling?"

There was an empty clearing behind the estate, though Jakyeong doubted the soil was meant for agriculture.

"The soil is rich," Il-hyun murmured casually. "The melons will thrive."

He spoke with such unwarranted confidence that Jakyeong had to ask: "How on earth do you know the soil is rich?"

"Because I've buried a shit-ton of bodies back there."

Jakyeong turned around with the cigarette still between his lips, staring at him. Seeing the unbothered, deadpan expression, he realized the man was entirely serious. Who in their right mind would want to eat produce grown out of a mass grave?

When Jakyeong pointed that out, Il-hyun merely shrugged, claiming flavor was all that mattered.

Telling him to eat the corpses himself, Jakyeong tried to head for the door, but Il-hyun caught him by the elbow, steering him toward the master bath instead.

"Let's shower."

"I want to head upstairs before everyone wakes up."

"Why bother? Everyone in this house already knows we're sleeping together. Even if we announced our wedding tomorrow, not a single person would bat an eye."

Jakyeong had zero counterargument for that.

Inside the steam-filled bathroom, unknotting the bathrobe quickly devolved into wandering hands and hungry mouths. Jakyeong found himself pinned against the wet tile, thoroughly taken apart for another round before they finally emerged.

In the dressing room, Jakyeong stared in pure disbelief at the silk tie in Il-hyun's hand.

The man had dressed in a bespoke charcoal suit, complete with his left arm meticulously strapped into the clinical sling. He tilted his chin, shamelessly asking Jakyeong to knot his tie because his "fractured" arm was in too much pain.

Who was the monster hoisting me into the air and pounding into me in the shower ten minutes ago?

Fuming at the blatant manipulation, Jakyeong looped the silk around Il-hyun's neck and yanked the knot tight, deliberately cutting off his air.

Il-hyun only offered a radiant, unbothered grin. "Careful... Pull any harder and I might come in my pants."

"Shut up."

"Watch your language. I am your employer, after all."

Jakyeong seized the opening. "If you're an employer, assign us a contract. Stop letting us lounge around eating on your dime."

"There's no work."

Jakyeong leveled a flat, deadpan stare. Look at that shameless face.

"Then can I stay outside the estate for a while? I promise I won't run off."

The food prepared by the housekeeper was exquisite, but living under a constant web of guards made him feel monitored. Wang Han felt suffocated by the lack of privacy and wanted an independent base to settle their ongoing affairs during their extended stay in Korea.

Meanwhile, Wang Ryun was still nursing a broken heart after his recent breakup, hoping to embark on an open-ended road trip across the country to clear his head.

Expecting heavy resistance, Jakyeong was surprised when Il-hyun gave an easy, casual nod.

"I'll have Tae-soo arrange a luxury penthouse in Seoul. It'll be more than enough space for the two of them."

For the two of them? Jakyeong tapped his own chest with a pointed finger. "What about me?"

Il-hyun tilted his head, his dark eyes narrowing into dangerous, sharp slits as he rolled his tongue across his teeth.

"Those two are fine. But what possible reason do you have to leave my side?"

"I'm not leaving permanently," Jakyeong explained. With the immediate threats neutralized, he wanted to spend a quiet month on a remote island—meditating, fishing, hunting, and recovering from the relentless grind of wet-work.

During their previous stint hiding out on an offshore islet, life had been surprisingly peaceful—right up until Kang Il-hyun had materialized in an attack helicopter, spraying automatic gunfire across the beach.

Listening to the pitch, Il-hyun let out a soft sigh, nodding reluctantly.

"Fine. One month. That's the limit."

"Deal!"

Jakyeong tried to suppress his excitement, but a brilliant, unrestrained smile broke across his face. Seeing the joy, Il-hyun’s brows furrowed in annoyance.

"Fuck... You're entirely too thrilled about this."

"N-No, that's not it," Jakyeong stammered, scrambling for an excuse. "I just... thought spending some time apart would make me appreciate your presence even more, President Kang."

Il-hyun scoffed at the transparent flattery. Feeling a twinge of guilt, Jakyeong reached up to smooth the crooked knot of his silk tie.

"When are you planning to go?"

"I'm not sure yet."

"Let me know the second you lock in the dates."

"Of course."

"I need to clear my calendar and take time off, too."

Jakyeong’s hands froze mid-motion around the collar. He looked up to find Il-hyun smirking with pure mischief.

"Why are you taking time off...?"

"Didn't you say your dream was to live on a deserted island with a wife, raising kids in domestic bliss?"

"Wh-Who told you that?!"

"Your brothers."

"..."

"I'll gladly play the role of your devoted wife. Though I'm afraid I can't bear your children."

"..."

"Should we bring a German Shepherd along instead?"

I should have known he'd never let me go alone.

Still, Jakyeong wondered if the man could truly afford to abandon corporate headquarters during such a volatile restructuring. Yet picturing the two of them fishing, diving, and roaming an isolated coastline together didn't sound terrible at all. Naturally, it would involve an absurd amount of sex, but the mental image of them scrambling through the surf brought a quiet, genuine chuckle to his lips.

"What's so funny?"

"Nothing."

"Liar." Il-hyun reached out, pinching Jakyeong’s cheek and tugging gently.

"Ouch, that hurts!"

As Jakyeong swatted at his wrist, Il-hyun wrapped an arm around his waist, capturing his lips in a firm, affectionate kiss. Despite Jakyeong’s feigned scowl, Il-hyun showered his face in a flurry of soft, lingering pecks.

"I'll take that as your consent. I'm submitting my leave request."

"Do whatever you want. You've already made up your mind anyway."

"I'll list the official reason as a honeymoon."

Jakyeong could practically hear the corporate gossip mill exploding already. After sternly warning him not to write anything so unhinged, Jakyeong smoothed the silk lapels of his suit jacket. Despite his grumbling, his hands were remarkably gentle.

Standing on his toes, Jakyeong pressed a soft kiss to Il-hyun's lips with an easy smile. "There. All done. Time for you to go to work."

Il-hyun didn't budge, his arm remaining locked tight around Jakyeong's waist. The playful, sweet kisses quickly deepened, turning thick, possessive, and hungry.

Jakyeong's back bumped against the polished mahogany display cabinet. As their breathing grew ragged, Il-hyun’s hand slid beneath Jakyeong’s shirt, broad palms roaming hot over bare skin.

"Wait... President Kang, your meeting—!"

"Fuck it," Il-hyun growled, his voice thick with raw heat. "Let's just leave for the island right now."

Jakyeong locked eyes with him, letting out a soft, helpless laugh before nodding.

Honestly speaking... whether it was a remote island or the edge of the earth, as long as it was with him, anywhere sounded perfect.

Catching the immediate surrender, Il-hyun’s lips curved into a radiant, breathtaking smile. Completely captivated, Jakyeong leaned in, sealing their mouths together once more.
